title: 3.1.B2 Build-Up — Rotate on Y
description: Add Y-axis rotation driven by frameCount to make the Spinning Sculpture's base cube spin.

steps.title: Spin bigCube on Y using frameCount
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `bigCube.rotation.y = radians(frameCount * 1.5)` to spin the cube on the Y axis at 1.5 degrees per frame.
hints: radians(frameCount * 1.5) converts degrees to radians each frame. At 60 fps this completes a full spin in about 4 seconds.

requirements.title: Y rotation uses radians() and frameCount
requirements.description: bigCube.rotation.y is set using radians() and frameCount.
